itemPlus.Chair: The Captain's chair! Cushy. You push a couple of buttons on the panels next to it, but nothing happens.
itemPlus.Bomb: You’re poking around and find an odd item, and as you’re examining it, you slowly realize it’s an explosive— at least a decade old, but definitely still viable, still volatile, and now you’ve gone and touched it.

itemPlus.PhotoPlush: You're not sure what this is. There's some sort of gelatinous food and a picture next to it, but the meaning escapes you.
itemPlus.CandyBox: A box of what you think is candy. You open it, but the only thing inside is slime.
itemPlus.Flan: Gelatin on a fancy plate! You consider eating it but don't know how it got there. Can you even eat gelatin?
itemPlus.Grabber: A grabber thingamajig. What is this used for, and what is the puddle underneath it? Gross.

itemPlus.Armoire: An armoire. Probably full of things that don't fit you, unless this does happen to be your room... Maybe you should check it out. Just for curiosity's sake.
itemPlus.Desk: The desk has books and papers... Unfortunately, you can't read any of them.
itemPlus.Dresser: A dresser. There's nothing atop to look at, but you can stare into the rug instead.

itemPlus.JarCan: Shiny, shimmery, splendid! Was someone painting in here or something?
itemPlus.Microscope: You can't seem to see anything through it.
itemPlus.Book: A medical book... It was left open on a recipe for remembering things.
itemPlus.Computer: A computer monitor. It should be able to turn on, but you don't see any way to do so.

itemPlus.CreepyPlant: A budding plant. Looks creepy. You don't want to touch it.
itemPlus.Fizzy: A fizzy drink(?). Given that you don't know what this is, you should probably not drink it.
itemPlus.Fruit: This could be a watermelon, if a watermelon had innards that looked like a brain. Someone has scooped this one's meat out already.
itemPlus.Magma: Hot! Hot! Do not touch! Who leaves magma just lying around?
itemPlus.NotBacon: Some sort of meat strips. You wonder if it'd taste like bacon.
itemPlus.NotBrain: The meat of the not-watermelon fruit looks like a mushy brain. Why, you wonder, does it glow?
itemPlus.TouchDie: You don't know what these are, but you get the sense that they're very destructive.

itemPlus.Microwave: A microwave. Looks far more old-fashioned than anything in a spaceship should.
itemPlus.Tree: A potted tree..? Why is this on the counter? Does someone on this ship eat trees?
itemPlus.Grass: A pot of normal grass. Apparently the artificial lighting in here is good enough for grass - who knew!
itemPlus.Plants: A nice little display of fruit. Several items on this blanket look like pastries, but they're hand-picked from trees on Pas-IJ2.
itemPlus.Candy: Someone left some candy here. You pop a piece in your mouth. Mmm, citrus.
itemPlus.Cascoons: Are these... cocoons of some sort? Or just weirdly shaped candy? You poke one but still aren't sure.

itemPlus.Bracelet: Aha! You've found the bracelet! You pick it up.
itemPlus.Kaboom: If you ever need a weapon of mass destruction (or a workplace violation), you know where to look.
itemPlus.Lunchbox: Someone's missing their lunch. You wonder how long this lunchbox has been here.
itemPlus.FaceVase: "My face doesn't look like that vase!" ...But does yours?
itemPlus.Shelves: You don't know how to read any of these labels. You decide not to poke through these containers.
itemPlus.Drawers: You don't know how to read any of these labels. You decide not to poke through these containers.
itemPlus.FlightLog: The ship's navigation system is so messed up that all the flight logs for the last ten years can be found in this one tiny drawer.
itemPlus.Scary: You don't know how to read this label. You decide not to poke through it.
itemPlus.Grass: This is a bucket of... grass? It doesn't look very friendly.
